claims.summary: The original second-domain pair remains diagnostic: Gemma's apparent 98/A package contains foreign music-theory material and regrades 74/C with one P0; Qwen is 89/B with six named-reading identity P1s. A post-fix exact-Gemma browser run proves the compiler corrections and citation-calibrated grader at 99/A with zero findings, without becoming a matched promotion result.

Both retained malformed skeleton responses now replay into 12 complete sessions, 12 deterministic per-session assessments, and a 100% weight total. Recovery is narrow, structural, and disclosed; partial array objects still fail closed.

Scion's quiz repair path no longer hard-codes Music Theory or music-specific verification language. The deep grader blocks multi-signal music-theory leakage in non-music courses, including generic-profile courses, while a narrow Business Ethics citation vocabulary recognizes legitimate ethical-framework and product-safety sources without enabling a density quota.

Local-model health now separates started, completed, failed, and in-flight inner generations; body logs attribute inner calls to each HTTP envelope; real Local-provider Crucible runs receive the same extended generation cap as shim runs; imported evidence paths stay portable across worktrees.
